Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1054501. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as inner join, and filter by assay_chembl_id CHEMBL1054501, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
